_comment: Reference profile. Design point = legacy task condition (100 KCAS, 4000 ft). APPROXIMATE public figures.
name: c172x
description: Cessna 172 (JSBSim c172x), single piston, normal category

sources.geometry_inertia: JSBSim 1.3.1 stock model aircraft/c172x/c172x.xml (metrics, mass_balance) -- itself an approximate public model
sources.control_derivatives: c172x.xml aero functions Cmde=-1.28, Clda=0.23, Cndr=-0.043 (per rad)
sources.control_limits: c172x.xml FCS: elevator clipped to +/-0.34 rad (~19.5 deg), aileron -0.35/+0.26 rad (~17 deg avg), rudder +/-16 deg
sources.mass_lb: JSBSim c172x inertia/weight-lbs after load + trim in the legacy task (2480 lb: empty 1454 + point masses 686 + fuel)
sources.speeds_n: approx public C172 POH/TCDS figures: Vs clean ~48 KCAS, cruise ~115 KTAS, Vne 163 KIAS, normal category +3.8/-1.52 g
sources.max_thrust_lbf: rough estimate of static thrust for a 160-180 hp fixed-pitch prop; not measured
sources.flex_constants: Flight Dynamics final Phase-1 values (INTERFACE.md section 0, 2026-10-06 04:05 PT; flexwing.AIRCRAFT_PROFILES): fixed, not genes; section CG aft of the elastic axis (>= 0.02 chord); tip mass 0. Notional (typical ranges, not manufacturer data). Never passed to FD (FD applies its own copy); kept here for reporting and checked equal to FD's in tests.

_shared: Trim point, envelope (min_kcas, nz), pitch-command clamp, throttle_max and pitch/altitude gain bounds come from phase1_shared.json (see ALIGNMENT.md); the sources below still document them.
